scripts.build: npm run vendor && tailwindcss -i assets/css/app.css -o static/css/app.css --minify
scripts.watch: npm run vendor && tailwindcss -i assets/css/app.css -o static/css/app.css --watch=always
scripts.vendor: rm -rf static/js static/icons && mkdir -p static/js && cat node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js node_modules/htmx-ext-head-support/dist/head-support.min.js > static/js/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/driver.js/dist/driver.js.iife.js static/js/driver.js
